questions.question: Data can be assumed whenever required with logical explanation 1A During aerobic growth, suppose a genetically modified E.coli follows glucose oxidation (10) trough this route: Pentose phosphate pathway → oxidative phosphorylation → CO 2 and water. How many moles of ATP will be generated through this route? Compare energy produced via this route to energy produced by chemical oxidation of glucose. Due to human error, air supply stopped and above mentioned E.coli culture was growing under anaerobic condition. What products can be formed under such condition? Explain with equations. How many moles of ATP will be generated in this case? 1B Both Saccharomyces cerevisiae yeast and Zymomonas mobilis bacteria produce ethanol from (10) glucose under anaerobic conditions without external electron acceptors. The biomass yield from glucose is 0.15 g/g for yeast and 0.08 g/g for Z.mobilis. In both cases the nitrogen source is NH3. Both cell compositions are represented by the formula CH 1.800.5N0.2. What is the yield of ethanol from glucose in both cases? 2A With diagram, mention four methods for experimentally determining rate parameters for (10) Michaelis-Menten type kinetics. 2B Pseudomonas 5401 is to be used for production of single-cell protein for animal feed.
